## Preprints

### Signatures of loop quantum gravity in primordial black hole cosmologies

Antoine Dierckx, Sébastien Clesse, and Francesca Vidotto

*arXiv preprint · 27 May 2026*

We derive cosmological bounds on light primordial black holes that leave Planck-scale remnants. In the model we study, black holes born with masses near one tonne can reheat the early universe through Hawking evaporation and leave enough remnants to account for the observed dark matter.

[arXiv:2605.28953](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28953) · [INSPIRE record](https://inspirehep.net/literature/3162406) · [Code](https://github.com/adierckx/pbh-rem) · [Slides](assets/talk_RERS8_20260526.pdf)

## Scientific software

### pbh-rem

*Release announcement · 27 May 2026*

A set of Mathematica notebooks for computing the cosmological evolution of primordial black holes and deriving abundance constraints for models with long-lived remnants.

[GitHub repository](https://github.com/adierckx/pbh-rem) · [Release notes](../posts/pbh-rem.qmd)
